model_dir.description: Folder with the detector model; empty = the model store

onnx_device.description: Where to run the network: auto (GPU when possible), cpu, gpu, gpu:N

batch_size.description: How many network windows are computed at once

ignore_start.description: Initial part where the network output is discarded (s)

tempo_distance.description: Smallest spacing of strong V peaks for the tempo estimate (s)

distance_factor.description: Smallest peak spacing as a fraction of the estimated syllable period

peak_height.description: Smallest peak height of a network curve (0–1)

skip_syllables.description: How many syllables to skip at the start (the first /pataka/ is a warm-up)

max_syllables.description: At most this many syllables after the skipped ones

min_syllables.description: Below this many detected syllables (including the skipped ones) the recording is not evaluated

language.description: Analysis language; empty = take it from the transcript

mattr_window.description: Moving window width for MATTR and PMI (words). The legacy script derived it from the shortest transcript in the batch

phnrec_dir.description: Folder with phnrec.exe and its model; empty = the model store

min_phones.description: Below this many recognised phonemes the output is discarded as unreliable

model.description: Segmentation source: auto (whatever is at hand), labels (finished labels only), pyannote, conformer

labels_dir.description: Folder with finished labels; empty = look next to the recording

cut_audio.description: Also save the cut-out speech as wav into the work folder

model_path.description: Path to the model file; empty = weights shipped with the library (conformer) or a download from Hugging Face (pyannote)

hf_token.description: Hugging Face token for pyannote; empty = from the HF_TOKEN variable

onset.description: Onset threshold of the pyannote binarisation

offset.description: Offset threshold of the pyannote binarisation

min_breath_duration.description: A shorter breath is relabelled as silence by the conformer model (s)

chunk_seconds.description: The conformer runs in windows of this length (s); 0 = the whole recording at once, memory then grows with the square of the length

runtime.description: What runs the models: auto (ONNX when exported, otherwise torch), onnx (without torch), torch

onnx_device.description: Device for onnxruntime: auto (GPU when possible, otherwise CPU), cpu, gpu or gpu:N

onnx_dir.description: Folder with the ONNX models; empty = segmentation-onnx in the model store

language.description: Language code of the recording; empty = let the model decide

compute_type.description: Computation precision; auto picks the fastest one the device supports. Manual choices are e.g. float16, int8_float16 or int8

condition_on_previous_text.description: Give the model the previous text as context. Off prevents hallucination loops in pathological speech and is faster; on keeps coherence in clean long speech

word_timestamps.description: Also return timestamps of individual words (needed for speech rate)

drop_repetitions.description: Drop repeated phrases, a typical sign of Whisper hallucination

repetition_min_count.description: How many times a phrase must repeat to be shortened
